assumptions: The checked action is a later distribution (distributeAll/notifyRewardAmount) occurring after voters reset totalWeight to zero.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the intended relation between the stranded balance and later distributions beyond 'later distributions do not touch the stranded balance'; the safety intent requires the emission to reach gauges' claimable, but no report-grounded expected claimable quantity is supplied to bind a correspondence between stranded balance and reward flow.

limitations: The selected impact is a negative statement about later distributions not touching the stranded balance; the intent's positive requirement (emission accounted to gauges' claimable) lacks a report-grounded expected quantity, so the correspondence is only partially bound.
Whether notifyRewardAmount is called directly or via distributeAll is not specified; the action is modeled as a later distribution per the ambiguity note.
